title: EvidenceAtom
description: SP-PATT-WARR-001 §2.1. A provenance-addressed observation contributing to a pattern warrant. An observation is an addressable atom, never a counter increment. Every contribution to W_p (SP-PW-R1) must be traceable to a set of these.

id.description: Content-hash / provenance address of this observation.

principal.description: PrincipalId that generated the observation. Drives the §2.2 concentration cap.

consentToken.description: ConsentAtom token, or null for non-consent-derived system telemetry. Revocation (§2.3) removes all evidence bearing a revoked token.

payloadDigest.description: Hash of the underlying payload; the payload itself is not carried.

sourceLocator.description: WHERE in the source this observation was drawn from. payloadDigest answers 'is this the same payload'; it cannot answer 'which passage did this come from', so without a locator a reader cannot check a claim against its source without re-deriving the whole document. provenanceVersion states the grade actually carried, so a document-only locator is never mistaken for a located one. Absent means the emitter recorded no position at all — which is a weaker claim than recording 'document-only', because it is silent about whether a position was even available.

provenanceVersion.description: document-only: the source is identified, the position within it is not. chunk-ordinal: an index into a chunking, which resolves only if that chunking is reproduced identically — it points into a derived artifact, not into the source. character-span: a half-open [start,end) range over the extracted text, resolvable without re-running the chunker.

sourceRef.description: Identifier of the source document the position is relative to.

extractionDigest.description: Digest of the extracted text the offsets index into. The same document extracted by a different pipeline yields different offsets, so a verifier must be able to confirm it holds the same extraction before trusting a span.

weightAtObservation.description: Optional pre-decay weight; decay (§3.1) is applied by the scorer as a function of manifest class, not stored here.
